## Method overview

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Family / class** | Dynamic pool models → Equilibrium per-recruit |
| **Method name** | LBSPR |
| **Short description** | Estimates the spawning potential ratio from the length composition of the catch, using life-history ratios ($M/k$, $L_\infty$, $L_{50}$) and an equilibrium growth-type-group model. |
| **Main outputs** | SPR and proxy fishing status |
| **Typical use case** | Length-based (single fleet) |

::: {.callout-tip}

Can be reproduced as a configuration of [FLicc](flicc.qmd).
